title: Military battlefield studies
seo_description: Battlefield studies and staff rides in Italy for military units, led by former infantry officer Frank de Planta and tailored to your training objectives.
heading: Military battlefield studies
lede: Studies at Cassino, Anzio, Salerno and the Gothic Line, built around your training objectives and pitched to every rank in the group.
body:
Frank is a former Royal Anglian Regiment officer. He reads the ground as an infantryman and links the tactical action back to the operational and strategic picture. Where it helps, he draws out parallels with contemporary doctrine.

He has run single-day and multi-day studies for all-rank audiences and for multinational senior staff, at OR-4 to OF-8.
image_caption: Frank de Planta explains the D Company 2nd Battalion Duke of Cornwall’s Light Infantry diversionary attack on 11-12 May 1944 to soldiers from 2nd Battalion Royal Gurkha Rifles in June 2023.

steps.title: Objectives first.
steps.text: Tell Frank what the study is for, such as combined arms, river crossings, command at brigade level, or regimental heritage. He will propose the campaign and stands that fit best.

steps.title: Your dates and length.
steps.text: One day to a full week, for small command teams or for groups of up to 50.

steps.title: Preparation.
steps.text: Briefing packs for the group, with a reading list for those who want to go further. Syndicate tasks can be set on request.

steps.title: On the ground.
steps.text: Frank leads every stand himself, and transport stays with the group throughout.
